title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1973-12-02
lineage: DAT (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Transcendent soundboard recording captures a standout 1973 performance with superb instrument separation.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard tape is described as transcendent, offering beautiful instrument separation and even pitch‑correction that goes unnoticed. Reviewers rave about the overall vibe of the show, calling it a standout from ’73, though no specific songs are highlighted. Pairing this with the first set from the Dusborne matrix completes the concert experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the recording’s exceptional clarity and the show’s overall greatness, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Transcendent sound with beautiful instrument separation; pitch‑corrected (not noticeable), clear and balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer notes a unique vibe and calls the concert a standout of 1973, indicating strong overall performance despite no detailed song commentary.
